contexts.text: Truths in the ultimate of order falsified are the princes of Zoan, and the princes of Noph ().

The princes of Zoan have become foolish, the princes of Noph have been carried away () = that the truths of wisdom and intelligence from spiritual light in the natural man have been turned into the falsities of insanity. Zoan and Noph were in the land of Egypt, and signified the illustration of the natural man from spiritual light.
